description: "Lyrics of Earth" by Archibald Lampman is a collection of nature poetry written in the late 19th century. This work exemplifies the lyrical and evocative qualities characteristic of Canadian poetry during a period when themes of nature, life, and the relationship between humankind and the natural world were prominent.
